events.verdict: Booker (PHX) moves towards Conley (MEM) and makes knee-to-knee contact that affects his SQBR on the driving shot attempt.
Conley (MEM) gathers and takes two legal steps towards the basket.
Ayton (PHX) maintains legal guarding position at the end of Conley's (MEM) drive to the basket.
RLB shows Gasol (MEM) makes contact with Booker's (PHX) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
Gasol (MEM) firms up his position in Booker's (PHX) path and does not deliver the contact.
Ariza (PHX) establishes himself inbounds prior to making contact with the ball.
[Observable in enhanced review] Booker (PHX) lifts his pivot foot before the start of his dribble.
Mack (MEM) makes marginal contact with Booker's (PHX) arm that does not affect his SQBR.
Bridges (PHX) makes marginal contact with Conley's (MEM) body that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Conley (MEM) establishes himself in a screening position in Ayton's (PHX) path and absorbs the contact.
Conley (MEM) has his arms extended when he makes contact with Canaan (PHX), but the contact is marginal.
